description: Link a player profile to videos — pass video_ids OR folder_id (every video in that folder, any status; subfolders are not included). A video that had its own customized player (exclusive profile) loses that customization. Up to 5 video_ids are applied immediately; more videos, or any folder_id, are queued and return status 'pending' — confirm later with panda_get_profile (videos_count). Returns {status, message}.

folder_id.description: Folder ID — applies to all its videos (instead of video_ids)

video_ids.description: List of video IDs to apply the profile to (max 50)

name: panda_apply_profile_to_videos
title: Apply Profile to Videos
